sentences.text: In 2025, a town in Sweden put its church on wheels and drove it five kilometres across town.
Kiruna sits far above the Arctic Circle, right on top of a giant iron ore mine.
The mine built the town in 1900.
Now it was digging under the streets.
But the deeper it dug, the more the ground above it cracked.
Then in 2004, the town decided to move its whole centre three kilometres east.
The wooden church was built in 1912 and weighs about 670 tonnes.
You see, they didn't take it apart.
They lifted it onto steel beams and slid 224 wheels underneath.
It crept along at half a kilometre an hour.
So for two days in August, crowds walked beside a church rolling through town.
The town moved east, and this time, the church came with it.
